queen.name: Queen
queen.moves: any number of squares in any direction

rook.name: Rook
rook.moves: any number of squares horizontally or vertically

knight.name: Knight
knight.moves: L-shape: 2 squares in one direction, 1 in perpendicular

pawn.name: Pawn
pawn.moves: one square forward (two from starting position)

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.special_ability: teleport: can swap positions with any friendly piece once per game

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.moves: like a knight but 3 squares instead of 2
dragon.special_ability: fire_breath: can attack 2 squares in front without moving

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.special_ability: shield: protects adjacent friendly pieces from capture
